text.en: Clients frequently highlight prompt communication and friendly assistance from the salon team. Pet owners value the flexible scheduling and smooth intake procedure. While a passerby raised concern over unattended dogs near an open doorway, regular visitors commend the attentive staff approach.

Reviewers consistently praise the quality of haircuts and hygiene trims for both cats and dogs. Cat owners report excellent results with lion cuts and dematting, noting coats look tidy and refreshed. Dog owners also appreciate neat styling that keeps senior pets looking clean and well groomed.

Most pet owners emphasize that groomers show gentleness and patience with elderly or anxious pets, including senior cats and nervous dogs. However, feedback is mixed due to an incident noted by a motorist where leashed dogs stepped towards the street from an open doorway, urging strict entrance security.

q.en: Does Pets and the City provide cat grooming services?

a.en: Yes, the parlour regularly grooms cats, offering full lion cuts, sanitary trims, and dematting sessions for longhaired breeds.

q.en: Can owners book grooming for older or anxious dogs?

a.en: Yes, several clients note taking senior dogs to the salon, reporting that staff take time to make ageing pets comfortable during grooming.

q.en: Where is Pets and the City situated?

a.en: The shop and salon are located on South 17th Street in South Philadelphia.

q.en: Are prices considered reasonable by visitors?

a.en: Reviewers report that sanitary trims and feline haircuts are affordably priced relative to other local grooming parlours.
